Learned counsel for the appellant submits that, in respect of same project, co-ordinate Bench of this Court has enhanced the compensation in a sum of Rs.10,000/- (i.e., Rs.35,000/- +
Rs.10,000/-=Rs.45,000/-).
Therefore, in the present case also, same amount of compensation may be fixed.

2. Learned counsel for the respondents did not dispute the fact that the co-ordinate Bench of this Court in MSA Nos.25/2023 c/w 24/2023 by the considered Order dated 15.11.2024 has enhanced the compensation amount by Rs.10,000/- (i.e., Rs.45,000/- per gunta) for the acquired land.
Therefore, the appellant is entitled for compensation at the rate of Rs.45,000/- per gunta with consequential relief.

4. Accordingly, the following:
ORDER Sri Channappa vs The Special Land Acquisition Officer on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67520520/
2 (i) Appeal is allowed.
